title: From $3K to $270M: How He Did It (and How You Can Too)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Ryan discusses his own True Classic business and agency, and recommends named vendors and tools; no paid sponsorship is disclosed in the transcript.

stated_problem.quote: So, I went into solving the premium over gouging problem, the fit problem, and then just the comfortability problem
stated_problem.speaker: Ryan

idea.name: True Classic men's apparel
idea.one_liner: Sells comfortable, fitted men's apparel at accessible prices through its website and retail partners.
idea.customer: Men seeking better fitting, comfortable apparel at a lower price than premium brands.
idea.offer: Men's T-shirts and expanding apparel categories, initially plain shirts designed to improve fit and comfort.
idea.revenue_model: Direct product sales online and wholesale retail sales.

So I was just like, let me just focus my energy on one thing, the shirt, the t-shirt for men.

ideas.delivery: Apparel is manufactured, held and shipped through third-party logistics, sold direct online, and distributed through retail partners.
ideas.other_uk_rules: For a UK version, account for UK GDPR and PECR for tracking, cookies and marketing; consumer distance-selling and cancellation rights; product safety and textile fibre labelling; and transparent promotional pricing.
